title: Merge Intervals
hints: Merging pairs until nothing changes works but is O(n^2) or worse. What order of processing guarantees that an interval can only overlap the most recently merged one?
Sort by start. Then every interval either overlaps the last interval in your result (start <= its end) or begins strictly after it.
Keep an output list; for each interval in sorted order, if it overlaps the last output interval extend that end with max(ends), otherwise append it. Touching intervals ([1,4] and [4,5]) merge.
